title: History
summary: The map's own git history. Replay the map growing commit by commit on a timeline; open a node to see every commit that changed it, each traced from spec to issue to pull request to commit with links to the forge; and a History layer that shows how often and how lately each node changed.

add.label: history.js
add.desc: Reads the repo's history once per HEAD: each commit's pull request, issues, specs and the nodes it touched, and when each node was born.

add.label: history.js
add.desc: The History layer and replay on the map: halos by how often and how lately a node changed, nodes budding in as the timeline plays, and what a picked spec reached.

add.label: timeline.js
add.desc: The timeline strip: one mark per commit, play, step and scrub, and the trail of the commit at the playhead.

set.desc: The server: the page, its data, and the routes it allows, GET /api/history among them.

change.why: history is served by a new allowlisted route

set.desc: The Layers menu: the map's layers, the History layer among them, and in the Work view one layer per kind of work.
What is selected: a node with its history (each commit traced from spec to issue to pull request), or a piece of work with what it is connected to and its actions.

change.why: a node shows its commits and the trail behind each
